doc: I27 prereg instrument (the contract is the docstring of tests_m3/test_undo.py). Frozen at the I27 prereg; the build reads it and never edits it. sort_types: the I30 sidecar whose documents, binding and seeds the M3 machinery builds the extracted model from (Reach's initial state is the binding's deployment; witnesses replay on its step harness); UNDO reads the transitions documents it names and nothing else as law input (docs/HUMAN_ANSWERS.md Q19: the adopted extracted rollup document, never spec/M1/facts). observation: what one step shows (whitepaper Thm 6.9: outputs, success or revert): status, return or revert data, the target's logs and the target's external calls; compiler-generated getters are not actions of the document and are not observed. premise: nz, no hash value a law's steps compute is the zero word (a local premise like CF(h, S), Cor 6.16). search: the refutation budget (I30's argument and environment variants; prefixes up to prefix_depth, at most max_prefixes; continuations of at most continuation_depth steps; at most max_candidates candidates per law). basis: the prereg's computation of every pair, residue, classification, law and predicted outcome (tests_m3/test_undo.py::undo_basis_doc); the build never reads it. backtest: the frozen map from the M1 UNDO laws (spec/M1/facts/morph_rollup.json's names, read from their statements: a dead_residue law's projection, an undo_pair law's two actions) to the extracted document's names; the back-test alone reads laws/M1 and results/M1.
